title: Landing work, merge review and merge queues
situations: A verified change is ready to land.
A queued pull request stops, its base changes, or required checks disagree.
The user asks which commit actually landed and whether it was reviewed.
current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof. Commit-bound merge recovery routes methodless epic task reviews through the epic writer, preserves review bodies and reports failed requirement ids alongside successful recovery ids; failure blocks landing. A re-run Command case that rebased the lane is rechecked against the branch head it tested, and the landing refuses lane_head_superseded rather than force-push a superseded candidate. This behavior is source-observed, not verified-live.
questions: Audit merge candidate review, human review and queue CI reuse as distinct contracts; current map mentions approvals/QA but does not trace this complete landing family.
